item.title: Coupang and the Online Platform Act... Could They Become Obstacles to the South Korea-U.S. 'Nuclear Submarine' Push? (쿠팡·온플법 문제...한미 ‘원잠’ 추진 걸림돌 되나)
item.description:
Coupang and the Online Platform Act... Could They Become Obstacles to the South Korea-U.S. 'Nuclear Submarine' Push? (쿠팡·온플법 문제...한미 ‘원잠’ 추진 걸림돌 되나 )

South Korea and the United States have decided to launch a working group to implement the joint fact sheet agreed upon at last year's summit between the two countries. Discussions on the introduction of nuclear-powered submarines (SSNs) and the expansion of nuclear enrichment and reprocessing authority between South Korea and the U.S., which have been stalled for the past six months, may now gain full momentum. However, challenges are anticipated as the U.S. emphasizes the fulfillment of investment promises to the U.S. and the need for fair treatment of American companies. <<> According to the Ministry of Foreign Affairs on the 20th, the first meeting to implement the JFS in the security sector between the two countries will be held in South Korea next month. U.S. State Department Under Secretary for Political Affairs, Allison Hooker, is expected to visit South Korea leading a joint U.S. delegation in a few weeks. This follows a meeting on the 19th (local time) between South Korea's First Vice Foreign Minister, Park Yoon-joo, who is visiting the U.S., and Under Secretary Hooker, where they exchanged views on overall South Korea-U.S. relations, including JFS implementation, the Korean Peninsula issues, and regional and global situations. <<> The U.S. State Department stated in a press release that day, "We look forward to continued progress in the trade and industrial partnership between the two countries," while also emphasizing "the need to ensure fair treatment for U.S. companies and the swift removal of market access barriers." This is interpreted as highlighting the implementation of South Korea's investment promises to the U.S. and pointing to issues such as unfair treatment of U.S. companies like Coupang and South Korea's 'Online Platform Act,' which is cited as a non-tariff barrier. This means that issues such as investment in the U.S. and Coupang could act as stumbling blocks in security sector negotiations like nuclear submarines and enrichment/reprocessing. Our Ministry of Foreign Affairs did not include such content in its materials, prompting criticism that a gap in perception between the two countries has been revealed. <<> Meanwhile, according to data submitted by the Ministry of National Defense to the office of Representative Kang Dae-shik of the National Defense Committee on the 20th, the Navy recently submitted a request for a nuclear submarine to the Joint Chiefs of Staff (JCS). This request is the first official procedure in the acquisition process, where the military asks higher authorities for necessary items such as operational performance, operational concepts, required numbers, and deployment timelines when pursuing the introduction of a new weapons system or capability enhancement. The JCS is currently reviewing the Navy's request and is reportedly planning to hold a Joint Chiefs of Staff meeting this month to finalize the decision on nuclear submarine requirements. <<> Representative Kang Dae-shik pointed out, "While there have been important discussions recently, such as the phone call between the South Korean and U.S. leaders and the meeting of defense ministers, there has been no explanation at all regarding the plan to secure nuclear fuel. The priority should be to clearly explain the prerequisite condition of securing nuclear fuel to the public first." <<> The government is pushing to announce the 'Basic Plan for the Development of South Korea's Nuclear-Powered Submarine,' which will include South Korea's principles on securing nuclear submarines, construction plans, and its stance on nuclear non-proliferation, by the end of this month. The announcement of the basic plan is expected to present a specific timeline and a blueprint for South Korea's nuclear submarine program. (한·미 양국이 지난해 정상회담을 통해 합의된 한미 정상회담 공동 설명자료(조인트팩트시트) 이행을 위한 실무 워킹그룹을 출범하기로 했다. 지난 6개월간 답보 상태에 머물렀던 한·미 간 원자력추진잠수함(원잠) 도입 및 원자력 농축·재처리 권한 확대 논의가 본격 궤도에 오를 수 있다. 하지만 미국은 대미투자 약속 이행과 미국 기업에 대한 공정한 대우 필요성을 강조하고 있어 어려움도 예상된다.)

item.title: Lee Jun-seok on President Lee’s Review of Netanyahu Arrest Warrant: “Will You Also Arrest Kim Jong-un and Putin? Please Show Restraint” (‘네타냐후 체포영장 검토’ 李대통령에... 이준석 “김정은·푸틴도 체포할거냐, 제발 자중하라”)
item.description:
Lee Jun-seok on President Lee’s Review of Netanyahu Arrest Warrant: “Will You Also Arrest Kim Jong-un and Putin? Please Show Restraint” (‘네타냐후 체포영장 검토’ 李대통령에... 이준석 “김정은·푸틴도 체포할거냐, 제발 자중하라”)

Reform Party leader Lee Jun-seok on the 20th responded to President Lee Jae-myung’s order for the presidential office to review the execution of an arrest warrant for Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu if he enters South Korea, saying, “Please exercise caution and self-restraint.” (개혁신당 이준석 대표는 20일 이재명 대통령이 베냐민 네타냐후 이스라엘 총리가 한국으로 들어올 경우 체포영장을 집행하는 방안을 청와대에 검토해보라고 한 것과 관련해 “제발 자중자애하라”고 했다.)

In a Facebook post that afternoon, Lee Jun-seok stated, “Please become the President of the Republic of Korea who understands the weight of life and death in every word, not the Seongnam Mayor Lee Jae-myung who used to blurt out whatever came to mind on Twitter,” and added this remark. <<> Lee brought up incidents such as the North Korean shooting death of a South Korean civil servant in the West Sea and the sinking of the Cheonan, arguing, “If we follow President Lee’s standards, the first arrest warrant that should be issued would be for North Korea’s Kim Jong-un.” Regarding the attack on the ‘Namuho,’ a multipurpose cargo ship owned by South Korea’s largest shipping company HMM, in the Strait of Hormuz on the 4th, Lee said, “President Lee Jae-myung, who do you think attacked the Namuho? Do you have the courage to bring up an arrest warrant for that entity too? You remain silent on incidents where our citizens are harmed, yet you speak of arresting a foreign leader.” The government has confirmed the attack on the Namuho but has not yet identified the culprit. <<> He continued, “If you’re going to bring up warrants for foreign leaders, you should also mention Russian President Vladimir Putin. The ICC (International Criminal Court) already issued a warrant for Putin in 2023 on charges of unlawfully deporting Ukrainian children. If we follow President Lee’s standards, the South Korean government should first clarify its willingness to cooperate with that warrant. Would you arrest Putin if he visits South Korea?” <<> Lee noted, “Netanyahu is at least undergoing trial for his criminal charges, and the authority of Israel’s Supreme Court remains unchallenged. In a situation where you are dismantling the judicial system and demonizing the Chief Justice to avoid your own trial, calling for the arrest of a foreign leader who is silently facing his own trial could seem like turning the tables.” He then told President Lee, “The qualification to discuss arrest warrants for foreign leaders comes from someone who has at least the minimal conscience to appear in their own court.” <<> Earlier that day, during a cabinet meeting presided over at the presidential office, President Lee mentioned the arrest warrant issued by the ICC for Prime Minister Netanyahu, saying, “Hasn’t he been recognized as a war criminal by the ICC, and an arrest warrant issued?” This remark came while criticizing the Israeli navy’s seizure of an aid flotilla carrying South Korean activists approaching Gaza. <<> President Lee then said, “Until now, we may have considered diplomatic relations, but haven’t most European countries declared they would arrest Netanyahu if he enters their territory? Let’s also make a judgment on this.” In response, Presidential Security Chief Wi Sung-lac replied, “I will review it.” (이준석 대표는 이날 오후 페이스북에서 “트위터에 떠오르는 대로 아무 말이나 쏟아내시던 성남시장 이재명이 아니라 말 한마디에 나라가 죽고 사는 무게를 아시는 대한민국 대통령이 되어달라”면서 이같이 밝혔다.)

item.title: [Breaking News] Lee: "Demands for Pre-Tax Operating Profit Sharing, Some Unions Crossed the Line" ([속보] 李 “세전 영업이익 배분 요구, 일부 노조가 선 넘었다”)
item.description:
[Breaking News] Lee: "Demands for Pre-Tax Operating Profit Sharing, Some Unions Crossed the Line" ([속보] 李 “세전 영업이익 배분 요구, 일부 노조가 선 넘었다”)

President Lee Jae-myung said at a Cabinet meeting held at the presidential office on the 20th, "Sharing operating profits before taxes are deducted is something even investors cannot do," adding, "Some unions have crossed the appropriate line." This is interpreted as a remark aimed at the Samsung Electronics union, which has recently been demanding institutional distribution of pre-tax operating profits, citing strong performance. (이재명 대통령은 20일 청와대에서 열린 국무회의에서 “세금 떼기 전 영업이익을 나눠 갖는 건 투자자도 못하는 일”이라며 “일부 노조가 적정한 선을 넘었다”고 했다. 이는 최근 실적 호조를 이유로 세전 영업이익의 제도적 분배를 요구하고 있는 삼성전자 노조를 겨냥한 발언으로 풀이된다.)

In his opening remarks, the President mentioned a social "moral boundary (a line that should not be crossed)." He opened by saying, "For a society to function properly, we must adhere to an appropriate line," and "Although the law may not explicitly stipulate it, there is a common-sense level of moderation that all citizens agree on, and crossing that line causes harm to others and the community." (이 대통령은 모두 발언에서 사회적 ‘금도(넘지 말아야 할 선)’를 언급했다. 이 대통령은 “사회 공동체가 제대로 잘 작동하기 위해서는 적정한 선을 잘 지켜야 한다”며 “꼭 법률이 정하지 않았지만 상식적으로 우리 국민 모두가 동의하는 적절한 정도의 선이 있으며, 이 선을 넘어서면 타인과 공동체에 피해가 발생한다”고 포문을 열었다.)

He specifically pointed out the essence of the three labor rights guaranteed by the constitution and criticized the abuse of collective action rights. The President stated, "The three labor rights are meant to protect socially disadvantaged workers, and they involve the very important principles of solidarity and responsibility," and "They were not created to give force to a few individuals to push through something collectively for their own interests alone." (특히 헌법이 보장한 노동 3권의 본질을 짚으며 단체행동권 남용을 지적했다. 이 대통령은 “노동 3권도 사회적 약자인 노동자들을 보호하기 위한 것이고, 거기에는 연대와 책임이라는 아주 중요한 원리가 작용한다”며 “오로지 개인 몇몇 사람의 이익만을 위해서 집단적으로 뭔가를 관철해 내는 무력을 준 것이 아니다”라고 했다.)

He added, "Enterprises have investors (shareholders) who bear the risk and loss; fair compensation for labor must be guaranteed; and creditors, consumers, and the ecosystem of related businesses must also be protected," emphasizing, "No one should unilaterally cross the line." (그러면서 “기업에는 위험과 손실을 부담한 투자자(주주)가 있고, 노동에 대해서는 정당한 노동의 대가가 보장되어야 하며, 채권자·소비자·연관 기업 생태계도 함께 보호되어야 한다”며 “누군가가 일방적으로 선을 넘지 않아야 하는 것”이라고 했다.)

The President directly criticized the contradictions in the profit-sharing method demanded by some unions. He drew the line by saying, "It's fine for some labor unions to strive to achieve their interests, but there must be an appropriate line," and "Distributing profits from operating income is something investors and shareholders do." (이 대통령은 일부 노조가 요구하는 이익 공유 방식의 모순점을 정면으로 비판했다. 이 대통령은 “일부 노동조합이 자신들의 이익을 관철하기 위해 노력하는 것은 좋은데 그것도 적정한 선이 있어야 한다”며 “영업이익에 대해서 이익을 배분받는 것은 투자자가, 주주가 하는 것”이라고 선을 그었다.)

He further criticized, "Especially, demanding a certain percentage of operating income be shared institutionally before even deducting taxes, which is the public's share, is something even investors cannot do," and "Investors receive dividends from net profit after taxes, but (some unions' demands) are, to me, somewhat incomprehensible." This is a critique that the union is trying to touch pre-tax profits, which are the public's portion. (특히 “국민 공동의 몫이라고 할 수 있는 세금도 떼기 전에 영업이익의 일정 비율을 제도적으로 나눠 갖는다는 것은 투자자도 할 수 없는 일”이라며 “투자자도 세금을 떼고 당기순이익에서 배당을 받는데, (일부 노조의 요구는) 저로서는 약간 이해가 되지 않는다”고 했다. 노조가 공공의 몫을 떼기 전인 세전 이익에 손을 대려 한다는 취지의 비판이다.)

The President remarked, "Currently, we are seeing a trend of extreme polarization in many areas of society, with a lack of middle ground," and "Many are crossing the line, but history proves that such 'extreme crossing of lines' may seem helpful or beneficial in the short term, but in the long run, it is never so and will eventually lead to losses." (이 대통령은 “지금 사회 많은 영역에서 상당히 극단화되는 현상이 벌어지고 있고 중간이 잘 없다”며 “선을 많이들 넘는데, 이러한 ‘선 넘는 극단화’는 당장은 도움이 되거나 이익이 될진 몰라도 길게 보면 결코 그렇지 못하고 결국 손실로 돌아올 것임을 역사가 증명한다”고 했다.)

He continued, "Ultimately, the final responsibility for all these adjustments lies with the government," stating, "We must ensure that members of our society properly observe the appropriate line and enjoy their rights freely within it, but when the line is crossed, the government must fulfill its given responsibilities for the entire community." (그러면서 “결국 이 모든 조정의 최종 책임은 정부에 있다”며 “우리 사회 구성원들이 적정한 선을 잘 지키고 그 선 안에서 자유롭게 권리를 누리게 하되, 선을 넘을 때에는 사회 전체 공동체를 위해 주어진 책임을 다해야 한다”고 했다.)

In closing, the President advised, "Rights always come with duties, and authority comes with responsibility," and "Since there is yin and yang in everything in the world, let's think about how excess is worse than deficiency." (마지막으로 이 대통령은 “언제나 권리에는 의무가 따르고 권한에는 책임이 따른다”며 “세상 모든 일에는 전부 다 음양이 있는 만큼, 지나침은 모자람만 못하다는 점을 한번 생각해보자”고 당부했다.)

On the same day, Samsung Electronics' labor and management continued post-mediation at the Central Labor Relations Commission but failed to reach a final agreement. Consequently, the union will proceed with a general strike for 18 days starting from the 21st. In response, the presidential office stated, "We deeply regret the breakdown of the post-mediation at the Central Labor Relations Commission," and urged, "Even before the final deadline, considering the potential impact on the Korean economy, we ask for the best efforts to reach a labor-management agreement until the very end." (이날 삼성전자 노사는 중앙노동위원회에서 사후 조정을 이어 갔으나 최종 합의에 이르지 못했다. 이에 따라 노조는 21일부터 18일간 총파업을 진행하게 됐다. 이에 대해 청와대는 “중노위 사후 조정이 결렬된 것에 매우 유감이다”며 “최종 시한 전이라도 한국 경제에 미칠 우려를 고려해 마지막까지 노사 합의를 위해 최선을 다해주기 바란다”고 당부했다.)

item.title: Lee Seok-yeon: "I Was Bullied by a Cheong Wa Dae Administrator...I Have Never Experienced Such Rudeness in 40 Years of Public Service" (이석연 “靑 행정관에 갑질당해...40년 공직에 이런 무례 처음”)
item.description:
Lee Seok-yeon: "I Was Bullied by a Cheong Wa Dae Administrator...I Have Never Experienced Such Rudeness in 40 Years of Public Service" (이석연 “靑 행정관에 갑질당해...40년 공직에 이런 무례 처음”)

Lee Seok-yeon, chair of the Presidential Committee on National Integration, revealed on the 20th that he was bullied by an administrator at Cheong Wa Dae. He distributed evidence and a statement as a press release, claiming that an administrator from the Cheong Wa Dae Office of the Secretary for National Integration had bullied and excessively interfered with him, a deputy prime minister-level official. Chair Lee said, "In over 40 years of public service, I have never experienced such rudeness." (이석연 대통령 직속 국민통합위원장이 20일 청와대의 한 행정관에게 갑질을 당했다고 폭로했다. 청와대 국민통합비서관실 소속 행정관이 부총리급인 이 위원장에게 갑질과 과도한 개입을 했다며 관련 증거 자료와 입장문을 보도자료로 배포한 것이다. 이 위원장은 “40년이 넘는 공직 생활 동안 이와 같은 무례한 사례를 경험한 적이 없다”고 했다.)

In a statement released that afternoon, Chair Lee said that after receiving a request from Cheong Wa Dae to submit essential data related to state tasks by the 17th, he submitted the relevant materials on the 14th, but subsequently suffered unfair pressure from Cheong Wa Dae. Chair Lee stated, "After sufficient internal discussions, I, with the approval of the chair, conveyed the matters to be reported to the president to the relevant senior secretary's office. Nevertheless, a farce unfolded where (Cheong Wa Dae) pressured staff until Sunday night because their demands—which were practically unacceptable—were not reflected." Chair Lee did not specify in the statement what the 'practically unacceptable demands' from Cheong Wa Dae were. (이 위원장은 이날 오후 배포한 입장문에서, 청와대로부터 지난 17일까지 국정 과제 관련 필수 자료를 제출하라는 요구를 받고 14일에 관련 자료를 제출했지만, 이후 청와대의 부당한 압박에 시달렸다고 했다. 이 위원장은 “충분한 내부 논의를 거친 뒤 위원장 승인 아래 대통령 보고 사항을 관련 수석실에 전달했다”며 “그럼에도 불구하고 (청와대가) 자신들이 요구하는, 사실상 수용하기 어려운 사안이 반영되지 않았다는 이유로 일요일 밤까지 직원들을 압박하는 촌극이 벌어졌다”고 했다. 이 위원장은 청와대가 요구한 ‘사실상 수용하기 어려운 사안’이 무엇인지는 입장문에 구체적으로 밝히지 않았다.)

Chair Lee also disclosed an email sent to him directly by the Cheong Wa Dae administrator. In the email, the administrator said to Chair Lee, "The deadline for submitting essential data related to state tasks requested by the presidential office is today (the 17th), but it is being delayed due to a lack of communication from the committee. This is a serious matter that could cause disruptions to future state administration and presidential briefings." (이 위원장은 청와대 행정관이 자신에게 직접 보낸 이메일도 공개했다. 이 행정관은 이 위원장에게 이메일로 “대통령실 요청 국정과제 관련 필수 자료의 제출 마감이 금일(17일)까지이나, 위원회 측의 소통 부재로 지연되고 있다”며 “이는 향후 국정 운영 및 대통령 보고에 차질을 빚을 수 있는 중대한 사안임을 엄중히 고지한다”고 했다.)

Chair Lee described it as "a virtually warning email sent by a Cheong Wa Dae administrator to a deputy prime minister-level chair," adding, "It is very regrettable that such communication occurs at Cheong Wa Dae, the pinnacle of power in the public service." He continued, "This kind of bullying and excessive interference is by no means desirable. I have requested Chief of Staff Kang Hoon-sik to accurately understand the circumstances of this situation and take appropriate measures." (이 위원장은 “청와대 행정관이 부총리급 위원장에게 보낸 사실상의 경고성 메일”이라며 “공직 사회의 최고 권부인 청와대에서 이러한 방식의 소통이 이뤄진다는 것은 매우 유감스러운 일”이라고 했다. 그러면서 “이러한 방식의 갑질과 과도한 개입은 결코 바람직하지 않다”며 “강훈식 비서실장에게 이번 상황의 경위를 정확히 파악하고 적절한 조치를 취해줄 것을 요청했다”고 했다.)

Chair Lee also said, "I cannot help but feel sorrow at the reality where, recently, there have been repeated moves to meddle in the affairs of the National Integration Committee and myself on every issue and to apply unnecessary brakes." According to the National Integration Committee and ruling party officials, there have been ongoing conflicts, both large and small, between Cheong Wa Dae and the committee. (이 위원장은 “최근 들어 사사건건 국민통합위와 위원장 본인의 행보에 관여하고, 불필요한 제동을 걸려는 움직임이 반복되고 있는 현실에 서러움을 금할 수 없다”고도 했다. 국민통합위와 여권 관계자들에 따르면, 청와대와 국민통합위 사이에 그동안 크고 작은 갈등이 끊이지 않았다고 한다.)

Chair Lee, who previously served as Minister of Government Legislation under the Lee Myung-bak administration and was mainly active in the conservative camp, was recruited as co-chair of the joint election campaign committee by President Lee during the last presidential election. After being appointed as chair of the National Integration Committee, he has continued to offer sharp criticism, such as denouncing the ruling party's push for a law on distortion of law as "an unconstitutional idea and a disgrace to a civilized nation." A ruling party official said, "I understand that because Chair Lee is so harsh in his criticism, there have even been comments within Cheong Wa Dae wondering if he is going too far." (이 위원장은 이명박 정부에서 법제처장을 지내는 등 주로 보수 진영에서 활동하다가, 지난 대선 때 이 대통령에 의해 공동선거대책위원장으로 영입됐는데, 국민통합위원장에 임명된 뒤 여권이 추진하는 법왜곡죄에 대해 “위헌적 발상이자 문명국의 수치”라고 비판하는 등 쓴소리를 이어왔다. 여권 관계자는 “이 위원장이 워낙 세게 비판을 하니까 청와대 안에서도 ‘너무하지 않나’ 하는 말들이 나온 것으로 안다”고 했다.)

Chair Lee is scheduled to meet President Lee on the 21st at a meeting of presidential advisory councils and committees held at Cheong Wa Dae. Cheong Wa Dae responded to Chair Lee's allegations by stating, "We will review internal matters to understand the situation." (이 위원장은 21일 청와대에서 열리는 대통령 자문회의·위원회 간담회에서 이 대통령을 만난다. 청와대는 이날 이 위원장의 문제 제기에 “내부적 검토를 거쳐 파악할 예정”이라고 했다.)

item.title: Chaos in Pyeongtaek, Conservative Merger Whispered… People Power’s Yoo Ui-dong Says “Seriously Considering” (혼돈의 평택, 보수 단일화 꿈틀… 국힘 유의동 “진지한 고민”)
item.description:
Chaos in Pyeongtaek, Conservative Merger Whispered… People Power’s Yoo Ui-dong Says “Seriously Considering” (혼돈의 평택, 보수 단일화 꿈틀… 국힘 유의동 “진지한 고민”)

Yoo Ui-dong, the People Power Party candidate for the Pyeongtaek B by-election, said on the 20th that he is “seriously considering” a conservative merger. This marks the first time Yoo has hinted at the possibility of merging with Hwang Kyo-ahn, the Liberty and Innovation Party candidate also running in Pyeongtaek B. The Pyeongtaek B by-election features a five-way race, including Democratic Party candidate Kim Yong-nam, People Power Party candidate Yoo Ui-dong, Rebuilding Korea Party candidate Cho Kuk, Liberty and Innovation Party candidate Hwang Kyo-ahn, and Progressive Party candidate Kim Jae-yeon. <<> Appearing on YTN Radio today, Yoo responded to questions about a conservative merger, saying, “We cannot realistically ignore the demands of local residents.” He added, “There is public opinion among supporters that Democratic Party candidate Kim Yong-nam, who is embroiled in allegations of abusive behavior and assault, and Cho Kuk, who has a history of academic corruption, should not represent our district. We often hear people say, ‘Shouldn’t we unite the conservative voice?’ and it’s true that we are raising the level of serious consideration on this matter.” This leaves the door open for a potential merger with Hwang. <<> Regarding Hwang’s belief in election fraud conspiracy theories, Yoo acknowledged, “There are clear differences within the conservative camp,” but added, “The gap with Hwang is not as wide as with the Democratic Party or the Rebuilding Korea Party.” He emphasized, “We are taking the demands of local residents very seriously.” Earlier, Hwang also told this newspaper in a phone interview, “I will do everything possible for the right to win,” and noted, “When I was the leader of the former Liberty Korea Party, I also spearheaded a grand conservative integration.” <<> The multi-party race in the Pyeongtaek B by-election has made candidate mergers a late-stage variable that could determine the outcome. Recent polls show support rates among candidates are so close that no one can confidently predict victory. <<> In a wireless telephone survey of 500 voters in the Pyeongtaek B district conducted on the 16th–17th by Chosun Ilbo in partnership with Matrix, Cho Kuk received 26% support, Kim Yong-nam 25%, and Yoo Ui-dong 20%. The top three candidates are all within the margin of error (±4.4 percentage points). Liberty and Innovation Party candidate Hwang Kyo-ahn followed with 11%, and Progressive Party candidate Kim Jae-yeon with 6%. Another 12% said they had no preferred candidate, were unsure, or did not respond. <<> Tensions are escalating over a potential progressive merger. Democratic Party candidate Kim Yong-nam said on CBS Radio today, “As things stand, the possibility of a merger is very slim,” adding, “For a candidate merger to happen, a sense of solidarity must be built, but in this election, the Rebuilding Korea Party has shown an outdated election culture.” When the host asked, “Does that mean even if your party strongly urges a merger, you don’t intend to accept it?” Kim replied, “Yes.” <<> On the same day, Cho Kuk proposed a joint policy announcement at a press conference at the National Assembly, targeting Democratic Party candidate Kim Yong-nam and Progressive Party candidate Kim Jae-yeon. Cho stated, “I, Cho Kuk, will take the lead to ensure that the solidarity and integration of the democratic reform camp proceed in a predictable, orderly, and stable manner.” Regarding a conservative merger, he said, “In the current situation, the likelihood of a merger between Yoo Ui-dong and Liberty and Innovation’s Hwang Kyo-ahn is increasingly shrinking,” but added, “If such a scenario occurs and Yoo ends up taking first place in the polls, we must follow the people’s mandate.” (경기 평택을 국회의원 재선거에 출마한 국민의힘 유의동 후보가 20일 보수진영 단일화와 관련해서 “진지하게 고민하고 있다”고 말했다. 유 후보가 평택을에 출마한 자유와혁신 황교안 후보와의 단일화 가능성을 시사한 것은 이번이 처음이다. 경기 평택을 국회의원 재선거에는 더불어민주당 김용남 후보, 국민의힘 유의동 후보, 조국혁신당 조국 후보, 자유와혁신 황교안 후보, 진보당 김재연 후보가 5자 구도로 경쟁하고 있다.)

item.title: Lee: "Israel's detention of Koreans goes too far... Should consider an arrest warrant for Netanyahu" (李 “이스라엘, 한국인 나포 도넘어... 네타냐후 체포영장 검토해야”)
item.description:
Lee: "Israel's detention of Koreans goes too far... Should consider an arrest warrant for Netanyahu" (李 “이스라엘, 한국인 나포 도넘어... 네타냐후 체포영장 검토해야”)

President Lee Jae-myung on the 20th strongly criticized the detention of Koreans aboard an international aid ship headed to Gaza by Israeli forces, stating, "It is terribly inhumane and absolutely excessive." Regarding Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, he also said, "Isn't he recognized as a war criminal by the International Criminal Court (ICC) and subject to an arrest warrant?" proposing that if Netanyahu enters Korea, measures to arrest him should be considered. (이재명 대통령은 20일 가자지구로 향하던 국제 구호선에 탑승한 한국인들이 이스라엘군에 억류된 것에 대해 “너무 비인도적이고 도가 지나쳐도 너무 지나치다”며 강하게 비판했다. 베냐민 네타냐후 이스라엘 총리에 대해서도 “국제형사재판소(ICC) 전범으로 인정돼 체포 영장이 발부돼 있는 것 아니냐”며 네타냐후 총리가 한국으로 들어올 경우 체포하는 방안을 검토하자고 했다.)

During a cabinet meeting that day, President Lee inquired about the incident in which an international aid ship headed to Gaza was seized by Israeli forces, leading to the successive detention of Korean activists on board. According to the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, following the aid ship carrying Kim Dong-hyun on the 18th, another ship carrying Kim Ah-hyun was also seized by Israeli forces early on the 20th, resulting in two Korean activists being detained. (이 대통령은 이날 국무회의에서 가자지구로 향하던 국제 구호선이 이스라엘군에 나포되면서 탑승하고 있던 한국인 활동가들이 잇따라 억류된 사건에 대해 물었다. 외교부에 따르면, 지난 18일 김동현씨가 탄 구호선에 이어, 20일 새벽 김아현씨가 탄 구호선 역시 이스라엘군에 나포되면서 한국인 활동가 2명이 억류된 상황이다.)

President Lee said, "I hear that Israel is seizing or sinking ships, including those carrying our citizens who want to volunteer in Gaza. What is the legal basis for this?" He added, "Isn't this an illegal invasion and aggression by Israel under international law?" In response, National Security Office Director Wi Sung-lac said, "That part needs to be examined," adding, "The situation began when Hamas attacked Israel, killing nearly 2,000 people, which prompted Israel to impose military control over the region." (이 대통령은 “이스라엘이 가자지구에 자원봉사하러 가겠다고 하는 우리 내국인을 포함한 선박을 나포하거나 폭침시키고 있다고 하는데, 법적 근거가 뭐냐”며 “국제법적으로 (이스라엘이 가자지구를) 불법 침범, 침략한 거 아니냐”고 했다. 이에 위성락 청와대 국가안보실장은 “그 부분은 따져봐야 한다”며 “시작은 하마스가 이스라엘을 공격해 2000명 가까운 사람을 살상한 것으로부터 촉발했기 때문에, 이스라엘이 그 지역을 향해 군사 통제를 가하고 있는 상황”이라고 했다.)

President Lee repeatedly questioned whether Gaza is Israeli territory. When he asked, "Is it their land? Is it Israeli territorial waters?" Director Wi replied, "It is not Israeli territory." President Lee then said, "Then shouldn't we protest? Can you seize a third-country ship during combat? This goes beyond laws and basic common sense—isn't this also an issue of boundaries?" (이 대통령은 가자지구가 이스라엘 영토가 맞느냐고 여러 차례 언급했다. 이 대통령이 “지 땅입니까? 이스라엘 영해에요?”라고 하자, 위 실장은 “이스라엘 영토는 아니다”라고 답했다. 이에 이 대통령은 “그러면 항의해야 하는 것 아니냐”라며 “교전 중이면 제3국 선박을 나포해도 되냐. 법이고 자시고 기본적인 상식이 있는 것인데, 이것도 역시 선에 관한 문제 아니냐”고 했다.)

Director Wi said, "It's somewhat complicated regarding those individuals," noting, "Last time, we told them that Gaza is a restricted entry area and not to enter, but they entered anyway." In response, President Lee said, "Disregarding government policy and recommendations is an internal matter for us, but isn't it wrong to detain our citizens for reasons not justified under international law? In my view, this is too severe and inhumane." (위 실장이 “그 분들에 대해서는 좀 복잡하다”며 “지난번에도 저희가 가자지역은 입국 금지 지역이니 입국하지 말라고 했는데 입국을 한 것”이라고 했다. 그러자 이 대통령은 “정부 방침, 권고를 안 따른 거은 우리 내부의 문제고, 우리 국민을 국제법적으로 타당하지 않은 사유로 잡아간 건 맞지 않느냐”며 “제가 보기엔 너무 심하고, 비인도적이다”라고 했다.)

President Lee stated, "As far as I can see, most European countries have issued arrest warrants for Prime Minister Netanyahu and announced they would arrest him if he enters their territory. I see many are doing so, so let's make a judgment too." He added, "There are minimum international norms, but they are being violated. Act according to principles—we have endured too much already." (이 대통령은 “아무리 봐도 지금 유럽의 거의 대부분의 국가들이 (네타냐후 총리에 대한) 체포영장 발부해서 자기 국내로 들어오면 체포하겠다고 발표했다”며 “제가 보니까 상당히 많던데 우리도 판단을 해보자”고 했다. 그러면서 “최소한의 국제규범이라고 하는 게 있는 건데, 그걸 다 어기고 있다”며 “원칙대로 하라, 그동안 너무 많이 인내를 했다”고 했다.)

item.title: Busan North Gap in Turmoil… Han Dong-hoon Takes First Place in Three-Way Race (부산 북갑 요동… 한동훈, 3자 대결 첫 1위)
item.description:
Busan North Gap in Turmoil… Han Dong-hoon Takes First Place in Three-Way Race (부산 북갑 요동… 한동훈, 3자 대결 첫 1위)

In a survey conducted by Research & Research for Channel A from the 17th to the 19th on the Busan North Gap parliamentary by-election, Democratic Party candidate Ha Jung-woo received 32.9%, People Power Party candidate Park Min-shik received 20.5%, and independent candidate Han Dong-hoon received 34.6%. In the three-way race, the gap in approval between Han Dong-hoon and Ha Jung-woo stood at 1.7 percentage points (p), within the margin of error (±4.4%p). (여론조사 회사 리서치앤리서치가 채널A 의뢰로 지난 17~19일 실시한 부산 북갑 국회의원 보궐선거 지지도 조사에서 더불어민주당 하정우 후보는 32.9%, 국민의힘 박민식 후보는 20.5%, 무소속 한동훈 후보는 34.6%로 나타났다. 3자 구도에서 한동훈·하정우 후보의 지지도 격차는 1.7%포인트(p)로 오차 범위(±4.4%p) 안이었다.)

In hypothetical two-way matchups assuming conservative unification, Ha Jung-woo had 42.6% vs. Park Min-shik's 32.4%, and Ha Jung-woo had 37.6% vs. Han Dong-hoon's 44.1%. This survey was conducted via wireless phone interviews targeting 500 voters in the Busan North Gap district. (보수 단일화를 전제로 한 가상 양자 대결에서는 하정우 후보 42.6% 대 박민식 후보 32.4%, 하정우 후보 37.6% 대 한동훈 후보 44.1%였다. 이번 조사는 부산 북갑 지역 유권자 500명을 대상으로 무선 전화면접 방식으로 실시됐다.)

Earlier, a wireless phone interview survey by Matrix for Chosun Ilbo on the 16th and 17th targeting 501 Busan North Gap voters showed Democratic Party candidate Ha Jung-woo at 39%, People Power Party candidate Park Min-shik at 20%, and independent Han Dong-hoon at 33%. Another survey by Korea Research for MBC on the 16th to 18th targeting 500 Busan North Gap voters also recorded Democratic Party candidate Ha Jung-woo at 38%, People Power Party candidate Park Min-shik at 20%, and independent Han Dong-hoon at 33%. <<> Regarding the 'two strong, one moderate' structure, some within the People Power Party suggest that once the official campaign period begins on the 21st, Park, receiving party support, could close the gap. Both Park Min-shik and Han Dong-hoon are negative about artificial unification, but a conservative insider said, “If conservative unification happens, the ripple effects could impact the entire Yeongnam region election, so we are monitoring it closely.” (For details, refer to the National Election Survey Deliberation Commission) (앞서 조선일보 의뢰로 메트릭스가 지난 16~17일 부산 북갑 지역 유권자 501명을 대상으로 실시한 무선 전화 면접 조사에서는 민주당 하정우 후보 39%, 국민의힘 박민식 후보 20%, 무소속 한동훈 후보가 33%의 지지도를 얻었다. 코리아리서치가 MBC 의뢰로 지난 16~18일 부산 북갑 유권자 500명을 대상으로 실시한 무선 전화 면접 조사에서도 민주당 하정우 후보 38%, 국민의힘 박민식 후보 20%, 무소속 한동훈 후보가 33%를 기록했다.)

item.title: Will the Opposition Sweep All 5 Seats in Chungcheong and Gangwon, or Will the Ruling Party Defend South Chungcheong? (충청·강원 5곳, 與 싹쓸이냐 野 충남 방어냐)
item.description:
Will the Opposition Sweep All 5 Seats in Chungcheong and Gangwon, or Will the Ruling Party Defend South Chungcheong? (충청·강원 5곳, 與 싹쓸이냐 野 충남 방어냐)

In the elections for metropolitan mayors and governors in the Chungcheong and Gangwon regions (5 seats), the key question is whether the Democratic Party of Korea will sweep all seats or the People Power Party will defend some areas. In the 2018 local elections, the Democratic Party took all five, while in the 2022 local elections, the People Power Party swept them. Current polls show the Democratic Party leading in all five, but factors such as the narrowing gap for some People Power Party candidates and the undecided vote could become variables. On the first day of official campaigning, the 21st, both party leaders are visiting Chungcheong, a traditional swing region. <<> In the South Chungcheong governor election, the race is tightening, with People Power Party candidate Kim Tae-heum closing in on Democratic Party candidate Park Soo-hyun. A poll conducted by Korea Research, Daejeon MBC, and Chungcheong Today on the 16th-17th showed Park at 44% and Kim at 37%, an 8 percentage point difference, within the margin of error (±3.5 percentage points). In a Korea Research poll from the 26th-28th of last month, Park led 44% to 23%, a 21-point gap, but the margin has shrunk. The undecided vote was estimated at 19% in the Korea Research survey, leading to speculation that late-stage undecided voters could sway the outcome. <<> In the North Chungcheong governor election, a poll by K-Stat Research and KBS Cheongju on the 13th-15th showed Democratic Party candidate Shin Yong-han at 37% and People Power Party candidate Kim Young-hwan at 25%, a 12-point gap. However, the undecided vote was 35%. Considering that undecided voters in other regions hover around 20%, North Chungcheong is seen as having the most significant undecided variable. <<> The Daejeon and Sejong mayoral elections show strong Democratic Party momentum. In a Korea Research, Daejeon MBC, and Chungcheong Today poll on the 16th-17th, Democratic Party candidate Heo Tae-jeong led in Daejeon with 51% against People Power Party candidate Lee Jang-woo's 29%, while in Sejong, Democratic Party candidate Cho Sang-ho had 51% over People Power Party candidate Choi Min-ho's 24%. <<> In the Gangwon governor election, a Korea Research and KBS Chuncheon poll on the 11th-14th showed Democratic Party candidate Woo Sang-ho at 44.8% and People Power Party candidate Kim Jin-tae at 32.7%, a 12.1-point gap. However, with undecided voters at 20.8%, Gangwon is also expected to have an undecided vote factor. (충청·강원 광역 단체장 선거(5곳)에서 더불어민주당이 모두 석권할지, 국민의힘이 일부 지역을 방어할지가 관심사다. 지난 2018년 지방선거는 민주당, 2022년 지방선거는 국민의힘이 5곳을 모두 가져갔다. 현재 여론조사상 5곳 모두 민주당 우세인 가운데, 일부 지역 국민의힘 후보의 추격 흐름과 부동층 표심 등이 변수가 될 전망이다. 여야 당 대표 모두 공식 선거 운동 첫날인 21일 전통적인 스윙 보터 지역인 충청을 찾는다.)

item.title: Democratic Party: "Seoul and Yeongnam Are Extremely Competitive" People Power Party: "Closing the Gap at a Rapid Pace" (민주 “서울·영남 아주 치열” 국힘 “빠른 속도로 추격”)
item.description:
Democratic Party: "Seoul and Yeongnam Are Extremely Competitive" People Power Party: "Closing the Gap at a Rapid Pace" (민주 “서울·영남 아주 치열” 국힘 “빠른 속도로 추격”)

The official campaign period for the June 3 local elections and National Assembly by-elections began on the 21st. A total of 7,829 candidates running in 2,349 electoral districts have entered the race to win over voters' hearts during the 13 days from the 21st to next month's 2nd. Early voting will take place on the 29th and 30th, with the main vote scheduled for June 3. (6·3 지방선거와 국회의원 재·보궐선거 공식 선거운동이 21일 시작됐다. 2349개 선거구에 출마한 7829명의 후보가 21일부터 다음 달 2일까지 13일 동안 유권자의 표심을 잡기 위한 경쟁에 돌입한다. 사전 투표는 29~30일, 본투표는 6월 3일 실시된다.)

This election is the first nationwide vote held on the first anniversary of the launch of the Lee Jae-myung administration. The Democratic Party of Korea aims to complete the "liquidation of the insurrection" by sweeping control of local governments, following the legislature and executive branch. The People Power Party plans to check the dominance of the Lee Jae-myung administration and the ruling supermajority, while laying the groundwork for the next general election. (이번 선거는 이재명 정부 출범 1년이 되는 날 치러지는 첫 전국 선거다. 더불어민주당은 입법부·행정부에 이어 지방정부까지 석권해 ‘내란 청산’을 완성하겠다는 입장이다. 국민의힘은 이재명 정부와 거대 여당의 독주를 견제하고 차기 총선을 치르는 발판을 마련하겠다는 계획이다.)

Until last month, some predictions suggested the Democratic Party would take 15 out of 16 regions, excluding North Gyeongsang Province. However, amid controversies surrounding the "fabricated indictment" special counsel bill and a consolidation of conservative voters, both parties are now on edge. Various opinion polls show tight races within the margin of error between ruling and opposition candidates in Seoul, Daegu, Busan, Ulsan, and South Gyeongsang Province. Observers also note that it is too early to predict outcomes in South Chungcheong Province and Gangwon Province. A notable feature of this election is that Jeonbuk Province and Daegu, traditionally strongholds of the two parties for over 30 years, have become battlegrounds. (지난달까지는 민주당이 16곳 중 경북을 제외한 15곳을 차지할 것이라는 예상까지 나왔으나 ‘조작기소’ 특검법을 둘러싼 논란 등으로 보수 유권자들이 결집하면서 여야 모두 긴장하는 분위기다. 여러 여론조사에서 서울과 대구, 부산·울산·경남은 여야 후보 간에 오차 범위 안 접전이 벌어지고 있는 것으로 나타났고, 충남, 강원 등에서도 결과를 속단하기 이르다는 관측도 나온다. 30여 년간 여야 텃밭이었던 전북, 대구가 격전지가 된 것도 이번 선거의 특색이다.)

Democratic Party Secretary-General Cho Seung-rae told reporters on the 20th, "The race in Seoul will be quite intense, and it will be very competitive in the Yeongnam region." People Power Party Secretary-General Jeong Hee-yong said, "No region is easy, but the gap is narrowing at a very rapid pace in several areas." On the first day of official campaigning, the 21st, Democratic Party leader Chung Cheong-rae will start his schedule in Seoul and then head to Daejeon and South Chungcheong Province, while People Power Party leader Jang Dong-hyuk will begin in Gyeonggi Province and also visit Daejeon and South Chungcheong Province. (민주당 조승래 사무총장은 20일 기자들과 만나 “서울은 상당히 치열하게 전개될 것이고, 영남권은 아주 치열하다”고 말했다. 국민의힘 정희용 사무총장은 “쉬운 곳은 없지만, 여러 지역에서 매우 빠른 속도로 격차가 좁혀지고 있다”고 했다. 공식 선거운동 첫날인 21일 민주당 정청래 대표는 서울에서 일정을 시작해 대전·충남을, 국민의힘 장동혁 대표는 경기에서 시작해 대전·충남을 찾을 예정이다.)

National Assembly by-elections will also be held in 14 regions nationwide. The outcome of these elections, which feature candidates such as Jo Kuk of the Rebuilding Korea Party and former People Power Party leader Han Dong-hoon, is expected to have a significant impact on the political landscape. Elections for 16 superintendents of education, who will oversee local education for the next four years, will also be held concurrently. (전국 14곳에서는 국회의원 재·보궐선거도 열린다. 조국 조국혁신당 대표, 한동훈 전 국민의힘 대표 등이 뛰어든 이번 선거 결과에 따라 정치권에 적지 않은 영향을 미칠 전망이다. 앞으로 4년간 지방 교육을 책임질 교육감 16명을 뽑는 선거도 함께 치러진다.)

item.title: Jeong Won-oh: "Seoul's Rental Crisis Due to Oh"; Oh Se-hoon: "Democratic Party Mayor is Main Cause of Housing Crisis" (정원오 “吳 탓에 전월세난”… 오세훈 “민주당 시장이 주거난 주범”)
item.description:
Jeong Won-oh: "Seoul's Rental Crisis Due to Oh"; Oh Se-hoon: "Democratic Party Mayor is Main Cause of Housing Crisis" (정원오 “吳 탓에 전월세난”… 오세훈 “민주당 시장이 주거난 주범”)

In the Seoul mayoral election, the biggest battleground of the June 3 local elections, the ruling and opposition parties are locked in a tight race, while in the Gyeonggi governor and Incheon mayor elections, the ruling party holds an advantage over the opposition. (6·3 지방선거의 최대 승부처인 서울시장 선거에서 여야가 접전을 벌이는 가운데, 경기지사와 인천시장 선거에선 여당이 야당에 우위를 점하고 있다.)

In a mobile phone interview survey commissioned by Channel A and conducted by Research & Research from the 17th to the 19th, Democratic Party candidate Jeong Won-oh received 43.9% and People Power Party candidate Oh Se-hoon received 35.7%, with Jeong leading outside the margin of error (±3.5 percentage points). In contrast, a mobile phone interview survey commissioned by the Chosun Ilbo and conducted by Matrix on the 16th and 17th showed Jeong Won-oh at 40% and Oh Se-hoon at 37%, with the gap within the margin of error (±3.5 percentage points). <<> As the double-digit gap from the early stages of the election narrows, a sense of crisis is rising within the Democratic Party. Democratic Party Secretary General Cho Seung-rae said today, "The Seoul mayoral election is unfolding fiercely as expected," adding, "We will make our best efforts by pooling all the party's manpower and resources for victory." <<> Candidates Jeong and Oh each attended the two sessions of the Gwanhun Club debates held this morning. Though they did not face each other in person, they exchanged sharp remarks on issues such as real estate. Candidate Jeong said, "If Oh Se-hoon had kept his promises during his tenure as Seoul mayor, there would have been no jeonse and monthly rent housing crisis," adding, "Oh promised to supply 360,000 housing units within five years during the 2021 local election, but only about 39,000 units were supplied each year from 2022 to 2024." In response, Candidate Oh countered, "Former Seoul Mayor Park Won-soon (from the Democratic Party) lifted development restrictions on 389 redevelopment and reconstruction zones. He is the chief culprit among those who worsened Seoul citizens' housing crisis." <<> Today, at a plenary session of the National Assembly's Land, Infrastructure and Transport Committee, the Democratic Party and the People Power Party clashed over suspicions that the Seoul Metropolitan Government covered up the issue of 'missing rebar' in the GTX (Great Train Express)-A Samsung Station section. People Power Party lawmakers attacked, saying, "The Democratic Party opened the Land Committee targeting Oh Se-hoon," while Democratic Party lawmakers retorted, "If the National Assembly doesn't ask, who is supposed to resolve this issue?" Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport Kim Yoon-deok, formerly a Democratic Party lawmaker, said at the Land Committee, "The ultimate responsible party for the missing rebar incident is the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport," but added, "Seoul City is not free from responsibility. Candidate Oh should also kneel and apologize to the public." In response, Candidate Oh shot back on Facebook, asking, "While Seoul City proactively identified the risk and set up measures to share with the government multiple times, what substantive actions did the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport and the National Railway Corporation actually take?" <<> Meanwhile, in the Gyeonggi governor and Incheon mayor elections, Democratic Party candidates are significantly ahead of their opposition counterparts. In a Gyeonggi governor election poll (ARS) commissioned by Straight News and conducted by Jo Won C&I on the 14th and 15th, Democratic Party candidate Choo Mi-ae received 47.9%, leading People Power Party candidate Yang Hyang-ja (33.8%) and Reform Party candidate Cho Eung-cheon (5.5%). During the same period, in an Incheon mayor poll (ARS) commissioned by Gyeonggi Ilbo and conducted by Jo Won C&I, Democratic Party candidate Park Chan-dae received 48.6%, ahead of People Power Party candidate Yoo Jeong-bok (38.5%). (For details, refer to the National Election Survey Deliberation Commission) (채널A 의뢰로 리서치앤리서치가 17~19일 실시한 무선 전화 면접 조사에서는 더불어민주당 정원오 후보 43.9%, 국민의힘 오세훈 후보 35.7%로, 정 후보가 오차범위(±3.5%포인트) 밖에서 앞섰다. 반면 조선일보가 메트릭스에 의뢰해 16~17일 실시한 무선 전화 면접 조사에선 정원오 후보가 40%, 오세훈 후보가 37%로 격차가 오차범위(±3.5%포인트) 내였다.)

item.title: Lee Seok-yeon: "Cheong Wa Dae Administrator Abused Power, Unprecedented in 40 Years of Public Service" (이석연 “靑 행정관이 갑질, 40년 공직에 이런 일은 처음”)
item.description:
Lee Seok-yeon: "Cheong Wa Dae Administrator Abused Power, Unprecedented in 40 Years of Public Service" (이석연 “靑 행정관이 갑질, 40년 공직에 이런 일은 처음”)

Lee Seok-yeon, chair of the Presidential Committee on National Integration, revealed on the 20th that he had been subjected to abuse of power by a Cheong Wa Dae administrator. He stated, "In over 40 years of public service, I have never experienced such a rude instance." Speaking to this newspaper, he said, "The unjust abuse of authority by Cheong Wa Dae staff is at a serious level," and added, "It must be swiftly improved for the success of the Lee Jae-myung administration." (이석연 대통령 직속 국민통합위원장이 20일 청와대 행정관에게 갑질을 당했다고 폭로했다. 이 위원장은 “40년이 넘는 공직 생활 동안 이와 같은 무례한 사례를 경험한 적이 없다”고 했다. 이 위원장은 본지 통화에서 “청와대 참모진의 부당한 권한 남용이 심각한 수준”이라며 “이재명 정부 성공을 위해 신속히 개선돼야 한다”고 했다.)

On the same day, Lee released a statement and disclosed an email sent to him by an administrator from the Cheong Wa Dae Office of the Secretary for National Integration. The administrator wrote to Lee, "The deadline for submitting essential materials related to the presidential office’s requested state affairs tasks was today (the 17th), but it has been delayed due to a lack of communication from the committee. This is a grave issue that could cause disruptions in future state affairs and reports to the president, and we are seriously notifying you." (이 위원장은 이날 입장문을 내고 청와대 국민통합비서관실의 한 행정관이 자신에게 보낸 이메일을 공개했다. 이 행정관은 이 위원장에게 “대통령실 요청 국정과제 관련 필수 자료의 제출 마감이 금일(17일)까지이나, 위원회 측의 소통 부재로 지연되고 있다”며 “이는 향후 국정 운영 및 대통령 보고에 차질을 빚을 수 있는 중대한 사안임을 엄중히 고지한다”고 했다.)

Lee commented, "This is essentially a warning email from a Cheong Wa Dae administrator to a vice prime minister-level chair," and added, "It is very regrettable that such communication occurs in Cheong Wa Dae, the highest authority in public service." He claimed that the relevant materials had already been submitted on the 14th. (이 위원장은 “이는 청와대 행정관이 부총리급 위원장에게 보낸 사실상의 경고성 메일”이라며 “공직 사회의 최고 권부인 청와대에서 이러한 방식의 소통이 이루어진다는 것은 매우 유감스러운 일”이라고 했다. 그러면서 이미 14일에 관련 자료를 제출했다고 주장했다.)

Lee further stated, "Nevertheless, a farce unfolded where (Cheong Wa Dae) pressured staff until Sunday night because their demands—which are practically unacceptable—were not reflected." The 'unacceptable demands' Lee referred to supposedly involved including Cheong Wa Dae personnel in overseas trips related to the committee's development of a 'National Integration Index' and having the committee cover the budget. Lee said, "This kind of abuse of power and excessive interference is never desirable," and added, "I cannot help but feel sorrow over the reality that there are repeated movements to meddle in my actions and impose unnecessary brakes on them at every turn." (이 위원장은 “그럼에도 불구하고 (청와대가) 자신들이 요구하는, 사실상 수용하기 어려운 사안이 반영되지 않았다는 이유로 일요일 밤까지 직원들을 압박하는 촌극이 벌어졌다”고 했다. 이 위원장이 언급한 ‘수용하기 어려운 사안’은 국민통합위가 준비하는 ‘국민 통합 지수’ 개발과 관련한 해외 출장에 청와대 인사를 참여시키고, 예산도 위원회가 충당하라는 내용이라고 한다. 이 위원장은 “이러한 방식의 갑질과 과도한 개입은 결코 바람직하지 않다”며 “최근 들어 사사건건 저의 행보에 관여하고, 불필요한 제동을 걸려는 움직임이 반복되고 있는 현실에 서러움을 금할 수 없다”고도 했다.)

Lee is a moderate conservative who served as Minister of Government Legislation under the Lee Myung-bak administration. President Lee Jae-myung recruited him during the last presidential election, appointed him as co-chair of the joint election campaign committee, and selected him as chair of the National Integration Committee shortly after the government was launched. (이 위원장은 이명박 정부에서 법제처장을 지냈던 중도 보수 인사다. 이 대통령은 지난 대선 때 이 위원장을 영입해 공동선거대책위원장에 임명했고 정부 출범 직후 국민통합위원장으로 발탁했다.)

However, it is known that there have been ongoing conflicts, both large and small, between Cheong Wa Dae and the National Integration Committee. In an interview with this newspaper in December of last year, Lee publicly criticized the Democratic Party’s bill to establish a 'special tribunal for insurrection' as unconstitutional, and regarding the 'crime of distorting the law,' he met with Democratic Party leader Jung Cheong-rae and described it as a "disgrace to a civilized country." It is also known that he secretly sent a letter to President Lee at the time, requesting the exercise of veto power. Additionally, Cheong Wa Dae reportedly indirectly conveyed that it would be better for Lee not to meet with conservative figures as part of his 'integration' plans. A ruling party insider said, "Because Lee’s remarks are too strong, there is a sentiment that he should resign on his own." (하지만 청와대와 국민통합위는 그동안 크고 작은 갈등이 끊이지 않았던 것으로 알려졌다. 이 위원장은 작년 12월 본지 인터뷰에서 민주당이 추진하는 ‘내란 전담 재판부’ 설치법에 대해 “위헌”이라고 공개 비판했고, ‘법 왜곡죄’에 대해선 정청래 민주당 대표를 만나 “문명국의 수치”라고 하는 등 쓴소리를 해왔다. 당시 이 대통령에게도 거부권을 행사해 달라는 내용의 서신을 비밀리에 보냈던 것으로 알려졌다. 청와대 측은 이 위원장이 ‘통합’ 차원에서 계획한 여권 인사와의 만남에 대해서도 ‘안 만나시는 게 좋겠다’는 뜻을 간접적으로 전달하기도 했다고 한다. 여권 관계자는 “이 위원장의 말이 너무 세다 보니 스스로 그만두길 바라는 기류도 있다”고 했다.)

In a phone call with this newspaper, Lee said, "I lost sleep for several days and agonized before writing this statement. The president is doing well, so approval ratings are high and the local elections are likely to be a landslide victory, but the staff seem to be complacent. That’s why I thought I should speak up. The staff need to understand the public’s fear." He added, "I have no personal motives," and said, "If my words are not accepted, I am ready to step down at any time." Cheong Wa Dae responded to Lee’s allegations on the same day, stating, "We will look into the matter through internal review." Lee will meet with President Lee at the Presidential Advisory and Committee Meeting scheduled to be held at Cheong Wa Dae on the 21st. (이 위원장은 본지 통화에서 “며칠간 잠을 설치며 고민하다가 쓴 입장문”이라며 “대통령이 잘하니 국정 지지율이 높고 지방선거도 압승할 분위기인데, 참모들은 자만에 빠져 있는 것 같다. 그래서 알려야 한다고 생각했다. 참모진이 국민 무서운 걸 알아야 한다”고 했다. 그러면서 “저는 사심이 없다”며 “제 얘기가 받아들여지지 않는다면 언제든 그만둘 생각이 있다”고 했다. 청와대는 이날 이 위원장의 문제 제기에 “내부적 검토를 거쳐 파악할 예정”이라고 했다. 이 위원장은 21일 청와대에서 열리는 대통령 자문회의·위원회 간담회에서 이 대통령을 만난다.)

item.title: Zero-tolerance Principle Applied to Illegal River and Valley Facilities ... Ruling Party Says "Will Strengthen Penalty Fines" (하천·계곡 불법 시설, 무관용 원칙 적용… 與 “과징금 강화할 것”)
item.description:
Zero-tolerance Principle Applied to Illegal River and Valley Facilities ... Ruling Party Says "Will Strengthen Penalty Fines" (하천·계곡 불법 시설, 무관용 원칙 적용… 與 “과징금 강화할 것”)

The Democratic Party of Korea and the government announced on the 20th that they will pursue measures to increase penalty fines by applying the "zero-tolerance principle" to illegal facilities occupying areas near rivers and valleys. This follows President Lee Jae-myung's directive during a cabinet meeting in February to crack down on illegal occupancy of rivers and valleys, and his reiteration on the 12th that "illegal valley facilities are a vestige of corruption," prompting follow-up actions. President Lee has consistently emphasized the cleanup of illegal valley facilities as a key achievement during his tenure as Gyeonggi Province Governor. (더불어민주당과 정부가 20일 하천·계곡 인근 불법 점용 시설에 대한 ‘무관용 원칙’을 적용해 과징금을 높이는 방안을 추진한다고 밝혔다. 지난 2월 이재명 대통령이 국무회의에서 하천·계곡 불법 점용에 대한 단속을 지시했고, 지난 12일 “계곡 불법 시설은 적폐”라고 재차 언급하자 후속 조치에 나선 것이다. 이 대통령은 경기지사 시절 계곡 불법 시설 정비 사업을 핵심 성과로 강조해왔다.)

Han Jeong-ae, chair of the Democratic Party's policy committee, said after concluding a ruling party-government consultation at the National Assembly that "we are preparing a bill to strengthen the penalty fine system to recover profits from illegal private gains." Kwon Chil-seung, a Democratic Party lawmaker and chair of the National Assembly's Public Administration and Security Committee, also stated, "In cases where individuals have occupied facilities for a long time and conducted commercial activities despite inducements for voluntary removal, we need to consider means to allow the state to claim restitution of unjust enrichment." The government estimates there are approximately 72,000 illegal facilities in rivers and valleys nationwide. (한정애 민주당 정책위의장은 이날 국회에서 당정(黨政) 협의를 마친 뒤 “불법적 사익 편취에 대해 이익을 회수하기 위한 과징금 제도를 강화하는 법안을 준비하고 있다”고 했다. 민주당 소속 권칠승 국회 행정안전위원장도 “자진 철거를 유도했는데도 전혀 따르지 않고 장기간 점유하며 상(商)행위를 한 경우에는 국가가 부당이득 반환 청구를 할 수 있도록 하는 수단도 검토할 필요가 있다”고 했다. 정부가 집계한 하천·계곡 불법 시설은 전국에 약 7만2000곳이다.)

The Democratic Party and the government plan not only to raise penalty fines but also to strengthen surveillance to prevent the construction of illegal structures. Additionally, the Ministry of Public Administration and Security will launch a support team for the maintenance of illegal river and valley facilities to pursue improvements in related laws over the next six months. Minister of Public Administration and Security Yoon Ho-jung stated, "We will strictly carry out maintenance under the zero-tolerance principle, but for facilities closely related to residents' livelihoods, we will establish reasonable standards considering on-site conditions." (민주당과 정부는 과징금 상향뿐만 아니라 불법 시설물을 짓지 못하도록 감시도 강화할 방침이다. 또 행정안전부 산하 하천·계곡 불법 시설 정비 지원단을 출범해 향후 6개월간 불법 시설 관련 법령 개선을 추진하기로 했다. 윤호중 행안부 장관은 “무관용 원칙 아래 엄정히 정비하되 주민 생활과 밀접한 시설은 현장 여건을 고려해 합리적 기준을 마련하겠다”고 했다.)

Local governments are also accelerating their crackdowns. Regions such as Yeongdeok-gun in Gyeongsangbuk-do, Dangjin-si in Chungcheongnam-do, Namyangju-si in Gyeonggi-do, and Chuncheon-si in Gangwon-do have formed dedicated task forces to conduct comprehensive surveys of illegal river and valley occupancy facilities. In some areas, restoration work is also underway on items such as platforms, temporary structures, and illegal commercial facilities near valleys. (각 지방자치단체도 단속에 속도를 내고 있다. 경북 영덕군, 충남 당진시, 경기 남양주시, 강원 춘천시 등은 전담 태스크포스(TF)를 꾸려 하천·계곡 불법 점용 시설 전수조사를 진행 중이다. 일부 지역에서는 계곡 주변 평상·가설 건축물·불법 영업 시설 등에 대한 원상 복구 작업도 병행하고 있다.)

The government explained that about 6,000 cases of illegal occupancy facilities identified so far are undergoing voluntary removal. However, for facilities installed for the common benefit of local residents, the government plans to consider installing alternative infrastructure, such as communal workshops at the local government level, to strike a balance between safety and resident convenience. (정부는 현재까지 파악한 불법 점용 시설 가운데 약 6000건은 자진 철거가 진행 중이라고 설명했다. 다만 마을 주민들이 공동 이익을 위해 설치한 시설의 경우에는 지자체 차원의 공동작업장 등 대체 인프라 설치도 검토해 안전과 주민 편의 사이 균형을 맞추겠다는 방침이다.)

item.title: From Presidents and Ministers to Party Leaders: Unrelenting Attacks on Starbucks Ahead of Elections (대통령·장관·당대표까지… 선거 앞두고 연일 스타벅스 때리기)
item.description:
From Presidents and Ministers to Party Leaders: Unrelenting Attacks on Starbucks Ahead of Elections (대통령·장관·당대표까지… 선거 앞두고 연일 스타벅스 때리기)

On the 20th, the ruling party launched a unified attack on Starbucks Korea for holding a "5·18 Tank Day" event. Ahead of the June 3 local elections, this controversy has sparked outrage over the trivialization of the Gwangju 5·18 Democratization Movement. (여권은 20일 ‘5·18 탱크데이’ 이벤트를 벌인 스타벅스코리아 때리기에 일제히 나섰다. 6·3 지방선거를 앞두고 광주 5·18민주화운동 등에 대한 희화화 논란에 불을 지폈다.)

President Lee Jae-myung said at a cabinet meeting that day, "Regarding the Gwangju 5·18 issue or its victims, things like 'How can anyone wearing a human face do such things?' happen quite often," adding, "Responsible figures commit such atrocities in public settings. How can that be called a human society?" (이재명 대통령은 이날 국무회의에서 “광주 5·18 문제나 피해자들에 대해 ‘어떻게 사람의 탈을 쓰고 그럴 수 있나’ 이런 것들이 상당히 많이 벌어진다”며 “공개된 장에서 책임 있는 인사들이 그런 만행을 저지른다. 그게 어떻게 인간 사회라고 할 수 있겠느냐”고 했다.)

Before the cabinet meeting, on X (formerly Twitter), he shared a 7-year-old advertisement from Musinsa for socks, with the caption "When I slammed the quick-drying desk, it dried up and crumbled," calling it "an ad that insults and mocks the death of activist Park Jong-chul from torture and the June Democratic Uprising that it sparked," and said, "Even if money is the devil, how can anyone wearing a human face do this?" Regarding Starbucks' "Tank Tumbler" sales event on the 18th, which used the phrase "Tap on the desk!", the president also said, "It's the inhumane, low-life behavior of a cheap merchant." <<> Democratic Party leader Jung Cheong-rae said at a party meeting that day, "For mockery or denigration of the 5·18 or other democratization movements, we will push for laws that allow stronger penalties," hinting at a possible bill before the local elections. He added, "The very act of Democratic Party candidates or campaigners entering Starbucks could give the public a very negative impression," and suggested, "Wouldn't it align with public sentiment to refrain from visiting Starbucks?" Immediately, Seoul Mayor Jung Won-oh and Gyeonggi Governor candidate Choo Mi-ae's camp issued orders to refrain from buying or using Starbucks products. That day, pro-ruling party internet communities posted photos of smashing Starbucks merchandise or cutting Starbucks gift cards with scissors. <<> The ruling party turned its arrows on the People Power Party, claiming the failure of a constitutional amendment to enshrine the spirit of the 5·18 in the preamble was the root of this incident. Justice Minister Jung Sung-ho wrote on Facebook that day, "If the amendment had passed the National Assembly threshold with bipartisan agreement, such depraved acts as Tank Day would never have even been dreamed of." The People Power Party opposed it as a "hasty constitutional amendment" and had proposed discussing it after the local elections. <<> The People Power Party refrained from commenting on the Starbucks event. Earlier, the People Power Party's Chungcheongbuk-do chapter posted on social media, "I'll drop by Starbucks tomorrow and then go to work," and Geoje City mayoral candidate Kim Sun-min commented, "I'll go get a sandwich," but after controversy arose, the chapter issued an apology. <<> However, People Power Party floor leader Song Eon-seok said regarding the Musinsa ad mentioned by the president, "That case was resolved seven years ago after the company offered a sincere apology," and asked, "Are you doing this because you're desperate for the elections?" In a spokesperson's comment, the People Power Party also called it "an attempt to demonize companies for political gain." The ad had sparked controversy in July 2019, and Musinsa apologized immediately. Musinsa issued another apology that day, saying, "We once again deeply apologize for the mistake we made in 2019." (국무회의에 앞서 X(옛 트위터)에도 ‘속건성 책상을 탁쳤더니 억하고 말라서’라는 무신사의 7년 전 양말 광고를 공유하며 “박종철 열사의 고문치사 사건, 그로 인해 시작된 6월 민주항쟁을 모욕하고 조롱하는 광고”라며 “돈이 마귀라지만 사람의 탈을 쓰고 이럴 수가 있느냐”라고 했다. 이 대통령은 전날 스타벅스가 지난 18일 ‘탱크 텀블러’ 판매 행사를 하면서 ‘책상에 탁!’이란 문구를 사용한 것에 대해서도 “저질 장사치의 비인간적 막장 행태”라고 했다.)

item.title: U.S. Deputy Defense Secretary Visiting Korea, Signals Pressure on Coupang and Online Platform Act… Could Become Obstacle for Nuclear Submarine Program (한국 오는 美 국방차관, 쿠팡·온플법 압박 예고… 원잠 추진 걸림돌 되나)
item.description:
U.S. Deputy Defense Secretary Visiting Korea, Signals Pressure on Coupang and Online Platform Act… Could Become Obstacle for Nuclear Submarine Program (한국 오는 美 국방차관, 쿠팡·온플법 압박 예고… 원잠 추진 걸림돌 되나)

South Korea and the United States have agreed to launch a working group to implement security commitments contained in last year's joint fact sheet from the South Korea-U.S. summit, including South Korea's introduction of nuclear-powered submarines. However, concerns are being raised that issues like Coupang could continue to be stumbling blocks, as the U.S. also emphasizes "ensuring fair treatment for American companies." (한·미 양국이 한국의 원자력 추진 잠수함 도입 등 지난해 한미 정상회담 공동 설명자료(조인트 팩트시트)에 담긴 안보 합의 사항 이행을 위한 실무 워킹그룹을 출범하기로 했다. 하지만 미국이 ‘미국 기업에 대한 공정한 대우 보장’ 등도 강조하고 있어 쿠팡 문제 등이 계속 걸림돌이 될 수 있다는 우려가 제기된다.)

On the 20th, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs announced that South Korea and the U.S. will soon hold a "kickoff meeting" to implement the security agreement. First Vice Foreign Minister Park Yoon-joo, who is visiting the U.S., met with U.S. Acting Under Secretary of State for Political Affairs Alison Hooker on the 19th (local time) and agreed to hold the first meeting. The U.S. State Department also stated on the same day that Acting Under Secretary Hooker would lead a joint U.S. government delegation to South Korea within a few weeks. (20일 외교부는 한미 양국이 안보 합의 이행을 위한 ‘킥오프 회의’를 곧 개최하기로 했다고 밝혔다. 방미 중인 박윤주 외교부 제1차관이 19일(현지 시각) 앨리슨 후커 국무부 정무차관을 만나 첫 회의 개최에 합의했다는 것이다. 미 국무부도 후커 미 국무부 정무차관이 수주 내에 미국 정부 합동 대표단을 이끌고 한국을 찾을 예정이라고 같은 날 밝혔다.)

However, the U.S. State Department said in its statement, "We look forward to continued progress in the trade and industrial partnership between our two countries," and "emphasized the need to ensure fair treatment for U.S. companies and the prompt removal of market access barriers." This is interpreted as targeting issues of unfair treatment of U.S. companies like Coupang and South Korea's "Online Platform Act," which has been identified as a non-tariff barrier, while stressing the implementation of South Korea's investment commitments in the U.S. South Korea's foreign ministry did not include such content in its materials. (하지만 미 국무부는 발표문에서 “양국의 무역 및 산업 파트너십의 지속적 진전을 기대한다”며 “미국 기업에 대한 공정한 대우 보장과 시장 접근 장벽의 신속한 해소 필요성을 강조했다”고 했다. 한국의 대미 투자 약속 이행을 강조하면서, 미국 기업 쿠팡 등에 대한 불공정 처우 문제나 비관세 장벽으로 지목해 온 한국의 ‘온라인 플랫폼법’ 등을 겨냥한 것으로 해석된다. 우리 외교부는 자료에 이 같은 내용은 포함하지 않았다.)

Meanwhile, according to data submitted by the Ministry of National Defense to the office of Rep. Kang Dae-sik of the National Assembly's Defense Committee on the 20th, the Navy recently submitted a requirement proposal for nuclear-powered submarines to the Joint Chiefs of Staff (JCS). The requirement proposal involves the military requesting necessary details from higher authorities when pursuing the introduction of new weapon systems, such as operational performance, quantity, and deployment timeline. This can be seen as the military's first formal step toward acquiring nuclear submarines. The JCS reportedly plans to hold a Joint Chiefs of Staff meeting within this month to finalize the decision on the nuclear submarine requirement. (한편 20일 국방부가 국회 국방위원회 강대식 의원실에 제출한 자료에 따르면, 해군은 최근 합동참모본부에 원잠 소요 제기서를 제출했다. 소요 제기는 군이 새로운 무기 체계 도입을 추진할 때 작전상 요구되는 성능, 대수, 전력화 시기 등 필요 사항을 상급 기관에 요청하는 것으로 원잠 도입을 위한 우리 군의 첫 공식 절차로 볼 수 있다. 합참은 이달 중 합동참모회의를 열고 원잠 소요 결정까지 마무리할 계획으로 알려졌다.)

However, Rep. Kang Dae-sik noted, "Regarding the plan to secure nuclear fuel, (the military) has not provided any explanation." The government initially planned to secure enriched uranium, used as fuel for nuclear submarines, through consultations with the U.S., but no progress has been made so far. The government is pushing to announce the "Basic Plan for the Development of South Korean Nuclear-Powered Submarines" by the end of this month, which will include the submarine construction plan and its stance on nuclear non-proliferation. (다만 강대식 의원은 “핵연료 확보 방안에 대해서는 (군이) 아무런 설명을 못 하고 있다”고 했다. 정부는 당초 미국과의 협의를 통해 원잠 연료로 쓰이는 농축 우라늄을 확보할 계획이었지만, 그간 진전이 없었다. 정부는 이달 말 원잠 건조 계획, 핵 비확산에 대한 입장 등을 포함한 ‘대한민국 핵추진잠수함 개발 기본계획’ 발표를 추진하고 있다.)

item.title: South Korean Ship First to Exit Hormuz… "Negotiated with Iran, No Tolls Paid" (한국 선박, 호르무즈서 처음 빠져나왔다… “이란과 협의, 통행료 안 내”)
item.description:
South Korean Ship First to Exit Hormuz… "Negotiated with Iran, No Tolls Paid" (한국 선박, 호르무즈서 처음 빠져나왔다… “이란과 협의, 통행료 안 내”)

The 'Universal Winner,' a very large crude carrier (VLCC) operated by South Korea's largest shipping company HMM, exited the Strait of Hormuz, effectively blockaded by Iran, on the 20th (local time). This marks the first passage of one of the 26 Korean-related vessels trapped in the strait since the outbreak of the US-Iran conflict in late February, ending their 81-day ordeal. The Korean-flagged Universal Winner, carrying 2 million barrels of crude oil, is scheduled to arrive at the port of Ulsan. (한국 최대 해운사 HMM의 초대형 유조선 ‘유니버설 위너호’가 20일(현지 시각) 이란이 사실상 봉쇄 중인 호르무즈 해협을 빠져나왔다. 지난 2월 말 미국과 이란 전쟁 발발 이후 81일 만에 호르무즈 해협 내에 갇혔던 한국 관련 선박 26척 중 한 척이 처음 해협을 통과한 것이다. 한국 선적인 유니버설 위너호는 원유 200만 배럴을 싣고 울산에 입항 예정이다.)

Foreign Minister Cho Tae-yul stated at the National Assembly's Foreign Affairs and Unification Committee that afternoon, "Our oil tanker is exiting the Strait of Hormuz through consultation with Iran. We have completed discussions with Iranian authorities, and it began its voyage yesterday, proceeding very cautiously." Bloomberg also reported that "the Universal Winner, loaded with Kuwaiti crude, began signaling on the morning of the 20th that it had entered the Iran-approved passage route through the Strait of Hormuz, south of Iran's Larak Island." (조현 외교부 장관은 이날 오후 국회 외통위에서 “우리 유조선이 이란 측과 협의로 호르무즈 해협을 빠져나오고 있다”며 “이란 당국과 협의를 마쳤고, 그래서 어제부터 항해를 시작해 매우 조심스럽게 (통과하고 있다)”고 했다. 블룸버그 통신도 “유니버설 위너호는 쿠웨이트산 원유를 선적했으며, 20일 오전 이란 라라크섬 남쪽 이란이 승인한 호르무즈 해협 통과 항로에 진입했음을 알리는 신호를 보내기 시작했다”고 보도했다.)

According to the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Iran notified the South Korean government through the South Korean embassy in Iran on the evening of the 18th that "passage through the Strait of Hormuz is possible" for the Universal Winner. After internal consultations with the shipping company, the Universal Winner began its voyage near Qatari waters early on the 19th, following the route designated by Iran, and exited the Strait of Hormuz on the 20th, arriving in the Gulf of Oman, considered a safe zone. There are reportedly around ten South Korean crew members aboard the vessel. (외교부에 따르면 이란 측은 지난 18일 밤 유니버설 위너호에 대해 “호르무즈 해협 통항이 가능하다”는 취지로 주이란 한국 대사관을 통해 우리 정부에 알려왔다. 선사 내부 협의를 거쳐 유니버설 위너호는 19일 새벽 카타르 인근 해역에서 운항을 개시했고, 이란이 제시한 통항로를 따라 20일 호르무즈 해협을 빠져나와 안전지대라고 볼 수 있는 오만만에 도착했다. 이 선박에 있는 한국인 선원은 10명가량이라고 한다.)

The government stated that no separate fees, such as "tolls," were paid to Iran during this process, and that consultations were held in advance not only with Iran but also with the United States. A government official said there were "no payments" made to Iran, adding that "critical matters are being closely coordinated with the US." The government maintains that Iran's permission for the passage of the South Korean ship is unrelated to the attack on the HMM NAMU on the 4th. (정부는 이 과정에서 이란에 ‘통행료’ 등 별도 비용을 지불하지는 않았고, 이란뿐 아니라 미국과도 사전 협의를 한 것으로 전해졌다. 정부 당국자는 이란 측에 지불한 비용은 “없다”며 “중요 사안에 대해서는 미국과 긴밀히 협의하고 있다”고 했다. 정부는 이란의 한국 선박 통행 허용이 지난 4일 발생한 HMM 나무호 피격과 관련 없다는 입장이다.)

However, there is speculation that Iran may have agreed to allow passage of the vessel from the same shipping company in response to the NAMU attack. After a container ship operated by Japanese shipping company Mitsui O.S.K. Lines was attacked on March 11, sustaining damage similar to the NAMU, three vessels from that company passed through the strait between April 3 and 6. Separately from investigating the facts of the NAMU attack, the government plans to continue negotiations with Iran to ensure that the remaining 25 ships can also exit the Strait of Hormuz. (하지만 이란이 나무호 피격을 의식해 같은 선사 선박의 통행에 동의했을 가능성도 제기된다. 지난 3월 11일 일본 해운사 상선미쓰이 소속 컨테이너선이 피격돼 나무호와 비슷한 피해를 입은 후, 4월 3~6일 이 회사 관련 선박 3척이 해협을 통과한 바 있다. 정부는 나무호 피격 진상 규명과 별도로 남은 25척 선박도 호르무즈 해협을 빠져나올 수 있도록 이란 측과 협상을 이어간다는 방침이다.)

item.title: “Korea and Japan Are an Economic Fate Community; Supply Chain Cooperation Creates Major Security Synergies” (“한일은 경제 운명 공동체, 공급망 협력 땐 안보도 큰 시너지”)
item.description:
“Korea and Japan Are an Economic Fate Community; Supply Chain Cooperation Creates Major Security Synergies” (“한일은 경제 운명 공동체, 공급망 협력 땐 안보도 큰 시너지”)

Experts on Korea-Japan relations attending the ALC stated, “Korea and Japan have become complementary ‘economic fate communities’ in future industries such as artificial intelligence (AI)” and described the two countries as “global partners that must cooperate on various challenges, including the Middle East crisis and the North Korean nuclear issue.” On the previous day, the 19th, President Lee Jae-myung and Japanese Prime Minister Takaiichi Sanae held a summit in Andong, North Gyeongsang Province, declaring the “strengthening of supply chain and energy cooperation.” This prompted suggestions that the two nations should closely coordinate not only in traditional security but also in advanced industrial sectors. <<> Koichi Hagiuda, acting secretary-general of Japan’s Liberal Democratic Party, said in a session titled “Strategic Environmental Changes and the Advancement of Korea-Japan and Korea-U.S.-Japan Cooperation” that “amid growing uncertainties in the international situation, Korea and Japan are in a complementary relationship in various fields, including semiconductors.” He added, “When two countries with technology and industrial bases that lead the world deepen their supply chain linkages, it creates incalculable synergistic effects even in terms of security.” He further stated, “Japan and Korea will develop cooperation while being conscious that they are indeed an ‘economic fate community.’” <<> Park Cheol-hee, a professor emeritus at Seoul National University and former South Korean ambassador to Japan, said, “Korea and Japan find themselves in similar positions in terms of military, economic, and energy security.” He added, “In the future, the two countries should cooperate further not only for their own interests but also to protect ‘international public spaces,’ including cyberspace, maritime space, and outer space.” This underscores the need for Korea and Japan to break out of the framework of a “bilateral relationship” and view current issues from a global perspective. Mark Lippert, former U.S. ambassador to South Korea and a senior advisor at the Center for Strategic and International Studies (CSIS), remarked, “Korea-Japan relations have rarely been this good, so we can view the cooperation between the two countries optimistically.” He added, “We must strive to secure strategic alignment among Korea, the U.S., and Japan.” <<> Akie Abe, wife of the late former Japanese Prime Minister Shinzo Abe, attended the ALC session titled “Toward a New Future for Korea-Japan Relations.” Ms. Abe stated, “Japan and Korea now understand each other with warm hearts and affection,” adding, “This understanding is possible because both countries are democracies.” Referring to the “Free and Open Indo-Pacific” vision proposed by former Prime Minister Abe, she noted that Korea-Japan relations are also developing into a more “free and open” relationship, grounded in youth exchanges and other initiatives. (ALC에 참석한 한일 관계 전문가들은 “한일 양국은 인공지능(AI) 등 미래 산업에서 상호 보완적인 ‘경제 운명 공동체’가 됐다”면서 “중동 위기와 북핵 문제 등 다양한 과제에 협력해야 하는 글로벌 파트너”라고 말했다. 전날인 19일 이재명 대통령과 다카이치 사나에 일본 총리가 경북 안동에서 정상회담을 갖고 ‘공급망·에너지 협력 강화’를 선언한 가운데, 전통적 안보뿐만 아니라 첨단 산업 분야에서도 양국이 긴밀하게 공조해야 한다는 제언이 나왔다.)

item.title: "North Korea Will Reach Out to US After Ukraine War Ends" (“北, 우크라전 끝나면 美에 손 내밀 것”)
item.description:
"North Korea Will Reach Out to US After Ukraine War Ends" (“北, 우크라전 끝나면 美에 손 내밀 것”)

On the opening day of the Asian Leadership Conference (ALC) on the 20th, former senior U.S. diplomatic and security officials stated, "North Korea is rapidly aligning with Russia since the outbreak of the Ukraine war, so it will not come to the negotiating table for the time being," but added, "Once the war ends, it will reach out to the United States and the international community." As North Korea's nuclear advancements have made denuclearization difficult to achieve in a short period, some argued that efforts should focus on resuming U.S.-North Korea dialogue under conditions such as arms control and nuclear non-proliferation. <<> Andrew Kim, former Deputy Director of the U.S. Central Intelligence Agency (CIA) who led backchannel negotiations between the U.S. and North Korea, said in a session titled "Revisiting North Korea: Pyongyang's Strategic Calculations and Diplomatic Possibilities," "Since the outbreak of the Ukraine war, North Korea has built a blood-alliance relationship with Russia, hunkering down and enjoying that bond, so it judges that meeting U.S. President Donald Trump would yield little benefit." <<> Former Deputy Director Kim added, "However, North Korea wants to be recognized as a normal state," and "At some point, it will inevitably engage in dialogue with the outside world." He cautioned, "While North Korea says it wants to be a friend of the United States, it only contacts us when it wants to, and then cuts off communication. That can never make it a friend of the U.S. North Korea must change first." <<> Marc Knapper, former U.S. Deputy Assistant Secretary of State for East Asian and Pacific Affairs and former Ambassador to Vietnam, said, "Looking at Ukraine, which gave up nuclear weapons after the Soviet collapse, and the fate of Libya's Gaddafi, who abandoned weapons of mass destruction (WMD) and was dragged through the streets and killed, Kim Jong Un has learned only one lesson: never give up nuclear weapons." <<> Joseph Yun, former U.S. Special Representative for North Korea Policy (and former acting U.S. Ambassador to South Korea), said, "If denuclearization of North Korea is set as a precondition, any dialogue becomes impossible." He added, "South Korea and the U.S. should pursue a 'Cold Peace' by starting with arms control discussions." In response to criticism that this would effectively recognize North Korea as a nuclear state, Yun countered, "Engaging in talks with North Korea about arms control or security does not mean recognizing it as a nuclear state. Ignoring the threat does not help solve the problem." (아시안리더십콘퍼런스(ALC) 개막일인 20일 미국의 전직 고위 외교·안보 당국자들은 “북한이 우크라이나 전쟁 발발 이후 러시아와 급속도로 밀착하고 있어 당분간은 대화 테이블에 나오지 않을 것”이라면서도 “전쟁이 끝나면 미국과 국제사회를 향해 손을 내밀게 될 것”이라고 했다. 북핵 고도화로 비핵화가 단시일 내 달성하기 어려워진 만큼, 군축·핵무기 비확산 등을 조건으로 한 미·북 대화 재개를 모색해야 한다는 주장도 제기됐다.)
